purpose: Semantic interpretation of earnings disclosures only. No price-direction prediction.

EARN01_guidance_direction.instructions: Based only on the supplied point-in-time company disclosure and prior context, classify the direction of forward guidance. Do not infer analyst expectations unless explicitly supplied.

options.none: No meaningful guidance in supplied text

EARN02_demand_signal.instructions: Classify the company-specific demand signal in the supplied disclosure versus the prior context supplied.

EARN03_margin_signal.instructions: Classify the margin/profitability signal in the supplied disclosure versus the prior context supplied.

EARN04_result_quality.instructions: Classify the economic quality of the reported quarter relative to the company's own prior trajectory and any explicit prior guidance in the supplied state. This is not a stock-price prediction.

options.strong_positive: Broad, material improvement with supportive quality

EARN05_novelty.instructions: How novel is the economically important information versus the prior context supplied?

EARN06_one_off_distortion.instructions: Are headline results materially distorted by one-off, non-operating, accounting, transaction, tax, litigation, impairment, or other non-recurring items?
